--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT

DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS = '2024-05-31'


DELETE FROM EDS.D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT WHERE Transaction_Date IN (SELECT Transaction_Date FROM D360.STG_EDS_D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT);

INSERT INTO EDS.D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT
(
	UserName
	,Account_Name
	,Channel_ID
	,Transaction_Date
	,Transaction_Time
	,Transaction_Reference_Number
	,Originator_Account
	,Beneficial_Account_Number
	,Transferee_Name
	,Biller_Mnemonic
	,Bank_Code
	,Transferee_Bank
	,Transaction_Category
	,Transaction_Type
	,Subscriber_Account_Number
	,Transaction_Currency
	,Transaction_Amount
	,Service_Currency
	,Service_Fee
	,Occurence
	,Device_Model
	,IPAddress
	,Status
	,Confirmation_Reference
	,Payment_Reference
	,Response_Code
	,Logged_Date
	,Logged_Time
	,CIF_ID
	,Account_Type
	,Product_Type
	,Terminator
	,BNK_CODE
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
	UserName
,	Account_Name
,	Channel_ID
,	Transaction_Date
,	Transaction_Time
,	Transaction_Reference_Number
,	Originator_Account
,	Beneficial_Account_Number
,	Transferee_Name
,	Biller_Mnemonic
,	Bank_Code
,	Transferee_Bank
,	Transaction_Category
,	Transaction_Type
,	Subscriber_Account_Number
,	Transaction_Currency
,	Transaction_Amount
,	Service_Currency
,	Service_Fee
,	Occurence
,	Device_Model
,	IPAddress
,	Status
,	Confirmation_Reference
,	Payment_Reference
,	Response_Code
,	Logged_Date
,	Logged_Time
,	CIF_ID
,	Account_Type
,	Product_Type
,	Terminator
,	left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,	substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT
WHERE H = 'D'
